2182. Dynamic Matrix Transpose Using Double Pointers

90

Hard

Write a C program to dynamically allocate a two-dimensional matrix using a double pointer and print its transpose.

Your program should:

Read the number of rows R and columns C.

Dynamically allocate memory using  int ** .

Read matrix elements.

Pass the matrix to a function named  transposeMatrix() .

Print the transposed matrix using double-pointer access.

Release all dynamically allocated memory.
input_spec:
First line contains R and C.

Next R lines contain C integers each.
